purpose: One bounded two-stage end-to-end integration, not new-method efficacy or independent confirmation
privacy: Reuse exactly the 39 already sanitized and visually reviewed images; no new images or protected sources
task_boundary: Engineering replay of existing single/multiple-image strata; NOT the old v5 diagnosis/comparison task definition and not a new clinical task or independent task-generalization test
exposure: All 24 sources have already appeared in the preceding four-arm development run. New role separation is within-run only; all reported results are exposed development replay.

components.memory: Existing ExperienceMemory, raw plus LLM abstraction, one candidate per stage
components.capabilities: Same six native tools and historical focused operation as known common prior; original skill evolution optional, min_source_tasks=2, empty allowed
components.routing: Existing Router semantic zero-to-two selection; at most one Optimizer-generated memory_selector artifact per stage
components.workflow: Fixed native MedRAX graph; no graph surgery

candidate_design: Both candidates originate from same deployed incoming state. Second reuses exactly the one memory proposal plus one generated memory_selector artifact. Evaluate both; commit highest admissible current score, tie favor memory-only. This joint alternative is declared, not two sequential accepted updates.

gate.default_optimizer_20_15_anchor_gate: not invoked; explicit native binary gate uses exact frozen counts, no screening or skip

evaluation: Training feedback only goes to proposal generation. Selection/anchor labels evaluator-only; report labels loaded after all states/predictions freeze. No test forgetting probes. No prediction cache. Native episodes and temporary memory state are read-only relative to the evaluated snapshot.
baseline: H0 and strong Fixed re-run on report cases under same visual repair/native budgets. S0 has the same known focused prior as Fixed; empty-memory S0 uses exact same context as Fixed. Do not import old scores as new controls.
stop: One run only; no result-driven thresholds, new samples, forced commits, extra candidates, or retry of completed episodes. At hard deadline preserve full denominators. No new experiments after 2026-11-09 09:22 Asia/Shanghai; remaining preparation is code/trace/report work.
engineering_success: Both stages execute real interactions; >=1 changed legal candidate per stage gets real selection evaluation; B real historical-anchor evaluation; gate decision and atomic state save/reload; terminal read-only report and explicit aliases. All candidates rejected is valid closure; all skipped is NOT.
public_boundary: Only code/config/aggregate/report, never images/questions/answers/source IDs/memory or individual traces
episode_accounting: 8 training + 8 reference-selection + 2 reference-anchors + 16 candidate-selection + 4 candidate-anchors + up to16 report (H0,Fixed,SA,SAB; S0 aliases Fixed). Invalid/unavailable selector reduces executed calls, but remains disclosed. B anchors only from A.
